scientific_integrity: The exact reduction is a finite exhaustive theorem over 225 tagged support pairs; the all-parameter counts follow by surjection weighting. Separate direct vertex enumeration supports but does not replace the infinite-family argument.
scientific_limitations: Only four colors, synchronous threshold-one successor-contact updates, complete bipartite labelled graphs. An unindexed equivalent is possible; 1993 full text was inaccessible and was not assessed as fully covering or excluding the theorem.
title: A six-cycle resonance and exact ten-class entrance law for four-color cyclic dynamics on complete bipartite graphs
